what: First-user walk-through of registering, publishing, running and judging a work procedure without tools, looking for where a non-developer would stop

product.built_from: main 88667199157da5a9688a91ac74273c1362c3f8a7 sources (build inputs), Open WebUI source 2a960a59fe1dbbd35282f0556b3666d81102e781, Node 22.16.0
product.server: tests/native_ui_fixture.py: the built frontend with synthetic sign-in, chat and model, and the real workflow service on a temporary database
product.account: synthetic non-admin user with the manager and participant roles on EMS / all factories
product.taken_by: one-off scripts outside the repository that subclass tests/test_ees_work_figma_authoring_native.py and click the real controls

captures.shows: First screen after sign-in for an account that may author: only "업무 절차를 선택해 주세요" and "게시된 업무 절차가 없습니다"
New procedure editor with the 단계와 작업 help box open: it covers the left menu, away from its question mark
Job detail as first opened: 수행 방법 and 확인 방법 side by side, no examples in 무엇을 확인하나요 and 완료 기준
Run screen of a stage with one human-check job before starting: 지금 실행 and 판정 필요
Same screen after the job was judged 적합: 1 / 1 완료, 지금 실행 is off and nothing says why or what comes next
The screen behind the stage "..." control: 진행 건 종료 sits beside 기록 JSON 내보내기; only after it can the work be started again
A job set to 확인 항목 · 항목마다 체크 opened during a run: no items, only 확인 완료, on a differently shaped screen
Job editor on a 1366x768 window: fits, the left menu shrinks to icons

not_covered: real team members, the in-house server, Windows browsers, the helper chat answers (the model is synthetic here)
